description: List Liquibase changesets not yet applied to the target database, as structured JSON. Reports up-to-date vs a pending list. liquibase is on PATH — no mise/wrapper needed.

changelogFile.description: Changelog path (--changelog-file); usually set in the defaults file instead.

cwd.description: Directory to run liquibase in (where the defaults file / changelog live).

defaultsFile.description: Path to the Liquibase defaults file (--defaults-file), e.g. db-dev.properties. Usually carries the JDBC URL, credentials, and changelog path.

extraArgs.description: Additional raw arguments appended to the liquibase invocation.

name: liquibase_status
title: Pending changesets (structured)
